en.headline: Ramadan: plan it with your doctor
body: Ask how to plan your meals and tablets.
Start the evening meal with water and dates.
Plain water is better than a sweet drink.
en.passage: see your doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan your medicines and meals

ms.headline: Bulan puasa: rancang dengan doktor anda
body: Jumpa doktor anda sebelum bulan puasa.
Tanya cara merancang makanan dan ubat anda.
Berbuka dengan air kosong dan kurma.
Air kosong lebih baik daripada air manis.
ms.passage: see your doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan your medicines and meals

zh.headline: 斋戒月：先和医生一起计划
body: 斋戒月之前，先去看医生。
问问怎样安排饮食和吃药。
开斋时，先喝水，吃几颗椰枣。
zh.passage: see your doctor one to two months before the fasting month to plan your medicines and meals
